title: Tool audit entry (the agent's AuditEntry)
description: PROVISIONAL. The line `executeGuardedTool` hands to its audit sink. Since V-02 (2026-10-23) EVERY call that reaches the gate leaves one, reads included. `decision` is a French, user-facing literal today and is expected to change when the journal is internationalised; `args` and `target` are masked (`redactValue` / `redactCommandText`) before they are cut. Closed field set: no token, no capability.

args.description:
JSON of the arguments, masked then cut at 500 characters; a cut value ends with the marker `
… [tronqué, N caractères de plus]`, so the bound is 500 plus the marker (measured: 537 for a 5000-character argument).

callId.description: The model's tool-call id, the one the conversation shows (`tool_id` on the wire).

tier.description: What the tool declares: `dangerous` → sensible, `audited` → audité, otherwise ordinaire. Absent for an unknown tool.

target.description: The tool's declared target (path, command, address…), masked then cut at 200 characters plus the marker.

durationMs.description: From the call reaching the gate to this line, the wait for approval included.
